```ruby title="Ruby"

begin
  result = LiterLlm.chat(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Very long prompt that exceeds the context window...', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
